title: INFRA-CLOSEOUT-MS0
brief: Hard-gate enforcement that every completed milestone is closed out across all four downstream roadmap surfaces (roadmap-index, MILESTONE_PROGRESS, BUILD_STATE, chat-bus). Origin: OCTOPUS-NEURAL-MS0 merge marked envelope completed but BUILD_STATE flagged drift indefinitely because the four downstream surfaces were never updated.
critical_path_role: infrastructure — never again let an envelope drift past close-out
source: in-conversation user directive 2026-05-12 — 'if we complete a task we need to close it out in the road map so it gets updated, make this a memory and whatever other enforcement system we have to make sure this always happens'
rationale: User reported OCTOPUS-NEURAL-MS0 still showing BUILD_STATE drift even though the merge had landed. Root cause: envelope was updated to completed but the four downstream surfaces (roadmap-index.json catalog, MILESTONE_PROGRESS regen, BUILD_STATE regen, chat-bus broadcast) were never touched. Three pre-existing roadmap hooks existed (stop_on_roadmap_drift, roadmap-completion-logger, roadmap-reconcile) but NONE were wired in settings.json. This milestone builds the orchestrator + hard-gate Stop hook + slash command + memory rule so the same drift class can never reach Stop again.

units.title: Build close-out orchestrator + Stop-hook gate + vitest + /close-out skill, then run live close-out on 9 drifted milestones
units.why: Drift in roadmap-index.json poisons every downstream audit and BUILD_STATE injection. A one-command orchestrator + a Stop hook that blocks the OCN class of drift makes the rule self-enforcing across all six chat lanes.

units.title: .gitignore additions + git-filter-repo history rewrite + force-push so origin/cad-fusion-live-ms0 actually accepts the close-out push
units.why: Without this, the close-out commit could not reach origin — the branch was 170 commits ahead with 100+ MB blobs baked into history (Whisper *.bin 3.2 GB, system-viz/system-graph.json peaks at 182 MB, audit.jsonl rotations) all blocked by GitHub's hard size limit. Stripping the auto-regen blob classes from history is the only way to land any future push.
